lines: Blue skies, sparkling waves, and a faraway horizonー
This was a beautiful luxury beach resort that took up an entire island.
Aina Winchester
Ooooh...
Aina
Ooooooh...
Aina
What is this, it's way too skimpy...
On the deck going down to the beach from the hotel...
She had tried many times to step out onto the beach, only to turn back and blush at her reflection in the glass.
Aina
I ain't goin' out to the beach in this outfit... I shoulda checked the size before I borrowed it.
Her bikini, with its design making heavy use of strings, was too small for her voluptuous body, and it looked like it was about to pop off at any moment.
Aina
Naaah～ this is a job! This ain't the time to hesitate!
She psyched herself up and took a step toward the beachー
Me
Pheeew, what a beautiful sea! Seems like this is gonna be a cushy mission.
It was a day at the beginning of summer. I'd set down on the southern island.
This island, which was within UFS territory but close to Japan, was a members-only luxury resort that made lavish use of the entire island.
It was said that there was a strict screening process to become a member, and that not only assets and social status, but also personal connections were checked.
And, should you ask what I was doing in such a place...
Me
(So, this is the resort that people keep disappearing from recentlyーhuh.)
Apparently, such stories had secretly become a problem among the wealthy since about six months ago.
Be that as it may, it wasn't possible to conduct a large-scale raid, as it was outside of the country, so a request had been made to the Taimanin to conduct reconnaissance.
Me
(Still, I can't believe my old man was a member here.)
Me
(That dirtbag of a father had the nerve to sneak around and enjoy himself at a place like this.)
Me
(Well, at least thanks to that, I got in without being checked.)
Headmistress Asagi and the others had racked their brains, wondering how to sneak investigators into this heavily guarded island,
but to my surprise I discovered that Fuma Danjoーmy fatherーhad held a membership here.
I was told that the membership had been automatically handed down to me after Danjo's death.
That was how I'd been able to boldly barge in here without raising any suspicions.
Me
Even so, there doesn't seem to be anything suspicious going on.
Me
Well, I came here to investigate, so I'll at least walk around a bit... Hm?
Flirtatious Man
Pheeew! Nice body, onee-san♪
Aina
Knock it off, I said stay away!
When I turned around toward the boisterous voices, I saw a single woman being pestered by several men.
Vulgar Man
And her swimsuit's sexy too!!! I can't get enough!
Flirtatious Man
The eyepatch is a little crazy, but that's A-okay too!
Aina
Cra-... No, this is...
It seemed like they were hitting on her. The men had surrounded the woman so she couldn't escape and were starting to shower her with crude laughter.
Me
(Pick-up artists, huh? I guess there's boorish guys wherever you go.)
Vulgar Man
You're here alone, right? How 'bout you hang out with us.
Aina
I-I told ya, I ain't that kinda...
Flirtatious Man
You're so～ bashful. With that swimsuit, you're asking for it for sure, aren't ya!?
Aina
You're wrong! This is...! Stop it! I said don't touch!!
The men had begun laying hands on her swimsuit and poking her skin.
Me
(Hey hey, that's going too far...)
Of course I couldn't turn a blind eye, and I quickly marched over towards the men.
Me
Hey, stop that. You can tell she doesn't like it.
Vulgar Man
What the hell'd you say? You wanna go!?
Me
Whoa there.
He turned around and shoved my shoulder, sending me staggering instantly.
Me
You're thugs who'd try to pick up girls at a place like this, so I figured there'd be no reasoning with you.
Flirtatious Man
Hm? What? You trying to pick a fight?
Me
I have no choice. And, well, if it's against guys like you, even I can handle it.
Vulgar Man
Fucking dick!! I'mma beat the crap outta ya!!
The pick-up artists, having lost their cool, came at me all at onceー
